title: candidate.contact_released payload
description: Payload of the candidate.contact_released event (candidate-service; docs/architecture.md §4.2). Mechanism for releasing contact data to the employer after invitation acceptance.

candidate_id.description: Identifier of the candidate whose contacts are released (candidate.profiles.id, logical reference).

contact_email.description: Released contact email; null when not provided.

contact_phone.description: Released contact phone; null when not provided.
